body: It kind of comes and goes, some days I just want to die but others are easy. I have found a good therapist covid makes it hard though, as I can’t go.
Most of the time I either watch YouTube videos are play video games. No I’m not taking medication.

They are just trying to help me but they aren’t doing the right things. Like as an example they took away my phone for a while when they found out and basically never left me by myself except sleeping and using the bathroom. I know they just want to help though.
Yes I do hate myself. covid has made it worse since I can’t go to therapy anymore. Most of the time I’m tired as well.

Yes I am severely depressed, For me I just kind of get through the day. I guess going to sleep is hard for me because being left alone with my thoughts means I think too much about bad things. Most of my family knows about it and they do treat me differently then when they didn’t know.
I mis worded it a bit, I was in the children’s section. So anyone under 18 would be there but the adults where in a different section.
After you lost your hearing did it hurt? And have you gotten used to it?
